The Puri School of Business offers a Master in Business Administrations (MBA) Degree which can be completed in less than two years. Consisting of 11 three-credit classes (eight core and three electives). The MBA program is designed for mid- and upper-level leaders that want to advance their career and personal achievements. In addition to outstanding opportunities to expand their global perspectives of leadership, marketing, finance, and business law, the program offers students an opportunity to complete a concentration in:

• Health Care Administration

• Organizational Leadership

• Project Management

• STEM Finance
